title: High Throughput MicroRNA Profiling: Optimized Multiplex qRT-PCR at Nanoliter Scale on the Fluidigm Dynamic ArrayTM IFCs
protocol: Add 1 ml Trizol Solution per 10 cm² dish area for cell homogenization.
Swirl and pipette up and down the Trizol around the culture dish to ensure full coverage.
Incubate the homogenized sample for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer the homogenized sample into a labeled tube.
Add 0.2 ml of chloroform per 1 ml Trizol solution and shake vigorously by hand for 15 seconds.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 3 minutes.
Centrifuge the sample at 12,000 x g for 15 minutes at 2 °C.
Transfer the colorless upper aqueous phase into a fresh labeled tube.
Precipitate RNA by adding 0.5 ml of isopropyl alcohol per 1 ml of Trizol solution.
Incubate the samples at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge the samples at 12,000 x g for 10 minutes at 2 °C.
Discard the supernatant from the tubes after centrifugation.
Wash the RNA pellet by adding at least 1 ml of 75% ethanol per 1 ml of Trizol solution.
Centrifuge the sample at 7500 x g for 5 minutes at 2 °C.
Discard the supernatant and centrifuge again for 1 minute.
Remove excessive fluid.
Air-dry the pellet for 5-10 minutes, being cautious not to over dry it.
Redissolve the RNA pellet in RNase free water by pipetting the solution up-and-down.
Incubate the redissolved RNA for 10 minutes at 55 °C.
Measure the RNA concentration (A260/280 ratio) using a Nanodrop™ spectrophotometer.
Store the extracted RNA at -80 °C until ready for use.
Thaw serum sample on ice.
Mix 300 μl of serum sample with an equal volume (300 μl) of room temperature 2X Denaturing Solution and vortex thoroughly.
Incubate the mixture on ice for 5 minutes.
Add a volume of Acid-Phenol:Chloroform equal to the total volume of the sample lysate plus the 2X Denaturing Solution.
Vortex mixture for 60 seconds.
Centrifuge at room temperature for 15 minutes at maximum speed (>10,000 x g).
Remove aqueous layer on top (should be 300 - 500 μl including any proteinacious "hazy" layer).
Re-extract aqueous layer by again adding chloroform.
Pre-heat nuclease-free water to 95 °C.
Add 1.25 volumes of 100% ethanol to the recovered aqueous phase and mix thoroughly.
Place a filter cartridge into one of the collection tubes for each sample.
Pipette the lysate onto the filter.
Centrifuge (10,000 x g) for 30 seconds.
Discard the flow-through.
Replace the filter cartridge into the same collection tube after centrifuging again for 30 seconds.
Apply 700 μl miRNA Wash Solution 1 to the filter cartridge and centrifuge for 15 seconds.
Discard the flow-through from the collection tube.
Replace the filter cartridge into the same collection tube.
Apply 500 μl miRNA Wash Solution 2/3, centrifuge for 15 seconds.
Discard the flow-through.
Repeat with a second 500 μl of Wash Solution 2/3.
Discard the flow-through and dry-spin for 1-2 minutes.
Place filter cartridge in a fresh collection tube.
Apply 100 μl RNAse free water (95 °C) to the filter cartridge.
Close cap and incubate for 2 minutes.
Centrifuge for ˜2 minutes to recover the RNA.
Store at -80 °C until use.

Mix DEPC-treated water, 10x cDNA archiving buffer, RNaseOUT, dNTP (100 mM), x-plex reverse stem-loop primer mix (40 nM), and MMLV reverse transcriptase according to the volumes specified for each component.
Centrifuge the prepared mixture briefly.
Add 3.5 μl of the master-mix to a 2 μl sample.

Perform RT-reaction at 16 °C for 30 minutes, followed by 60 cycles at 20 °C for 30 seconds, 42 °C for 30 seconds, and 50 °C for 1 second. Finally, incubate at 85 °C for 5 minutes to inactivate MMLV-RT.
Store the RT-reaction product at -20 °C until use.
Prepare a dNTP solution at 100 mM.
Mix 2x Universal PCR Master Mix with NoAmpErase UNG according to the manufacturer's protocol.
Design and prepare x-plex forward primer mix (450 nM).
Synthesize universal reverse primer (100 μM).
Prepare AmpliTaqGold polymerase solution at 5 U/μl concentration.
Prepare MgCl2 solution at 100 mM concentration.
Use DEPC treated water for all reagent dilutions and reactions.
Combine 22 μl of Universal PCR Master Mix with 5.5 μl of reverse-transcribed product to create a reaction volume of 27.5 μl.
Perform pre-amplification cycles based on the input RNA level, typically ranging from 12 to 16 cycles for optimal amplification and detection sensitivity.

Mix 13.75 μl of 2x Universal MM, 0.792 μl DEPC-Water, 0.55 μl MgCl2 (100 mM), 1.1 μl dNTP (100 mM), 3.06 μl x-plex forward primer mix (450 nM), 1.375 μl Universal RP (100 μM), and 1.375 μl AmpliTaqGold polymerase (5 U/μl) to prepare the Master-Mix.
Centrifuge the prepared Master-Mix briefly.
Add 22 μl of Master-Mix to each 5.5 μl RT-Product.
Perform a Pre-PCR reaction: heat at 95 °C for 10 min, then cool to 55 °C for 2 min, followed by 10 - 18 cycles of 95 °C for 1 s and 65 °C for 1 min, with final cooling to 4 °C.
Prepare a 10% polyacrylamide mixture: mix ddH2O (6.5 ml), 10x TBE (1 ml), Polyacrylamide (40%) (2.5 ml), APS (10%) (80 μl), and TEMED (4 μl).
Prepare DNA ladder by mixing 0.5 μl 10 bp DNA ladder, 4.5 μl Buffer (EB), and 1 μl 6x Orange G.
Mix 5.5 μl 6x Orange G with each 27.5 μl Pre-PCR product.
Run the gel at 150V for 55-60 minutes.
Stain the gel with SYBR-Gold for 25 minutes on a shaker.
Cut gel containing Pre-PCR product band from 60-80 bp.
Transfer cut gel band to labeled tube.
Incubate the gel-containing tube in 300 μl TEN-Buffer at 37 °C for 4 hours on a rotator.
Transfer fluid to a labeled collection tube.
Add another 300 μl TEN-Buffer to the gel-containing tube and incubate overnight at 4 °C on a rotator.
Aspirate remaining liquid from the gel-containing tube and transfer it to the labeled collection tube.
Record the total recovered volume of fluid.
Add 3 volumes of room temperature 100% ethanol to the solution.
Add 0.5 μl glycogen (20 mg/ml) to the solution.
Vortex the mixture thoroughly.
Incubate on dry ice for at least 2 hours or at -80 °C overnight.
Spin in a microcentrifuge at 4 °C for 30 minutes to pellet cDNA.
Dump the fluid and add 700 μl room temperature 75% ethanol, then spin for 10 minutes.
Dump the fluid again and spin for another 5 minutes.
Suck off supernatant without disturbing the pellet and air dry for 10 minutes.
Redissolve the pellet in clean water.
Mix 5 μl post-PCR product with 2 μl ExoSAP-IT.
Incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes to degrade remaining primers and nucleotides.
Add 5 volumes of Buffer PB to 1 volume of the PCR reaction and mix.
Place a MinElute column in a provided 2 ml collection tube in a suitable rack.
Apply the sample to the MinElute column and centrifuge for 1 minute.
Discard flow-through, place the MinElute column back into the same tube.
Add 750 μl Buffer PE to the MinElute column to wash and centrifuge for 1 minute.
Discard flow-through and place the MinElute column back in the same tube.
Centrifuge the column for an additional 1 minute at maximum speed.
Place the MinElute column in a clean 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
To elute DNA, add 10 μl DEPC treated water to the center of the membrane.
Let the column stand for 1 minute.
Centrifuge for 1 minute.
Inject control line fluid (150 μl) into each of the accumulators on the chip.
Run the Prime (136x) script to prime control line fluid into the chip.
Combine 2.5 μl of 2x TaqMan Universal Master Mix and 0.25 μl of 20x Loading Reagent in a disposable plastic tube to make the Sample-Pre-Mix.
Vortex and centrifuge the 96 well plate briefly to collect fluid.
Combine each sample with pre-sample mix (final volume per inlet is 5 μl).
Prepare slightly higher volume for pipetting loss.
Use a 96 well plate to prepare 13x assays.
Combine aliquots of the 13x assays with Tween for a 0.25% final Tween concentration.
Mix well, avoiding bubbles and centrifuge briefly to collect fluid.
Ensure all assay and sample solutions are mixed before loading the chip.
Fill unused sample inlets with 2.75 μl sample mix and 2.25 μl DNA-free water.
Fill unused assay inlets with 2.5 μl assay loading reagent and 2.5 μl water.
Do not go past the first stop while pipetting to avoid introducing air bubbles.
Run the Load Mix script (136x) to load samples and assays into the chip.
Remove the chip from the ICF controller after the script finishes running.
Peel the blue protective film from the underside of the loaded chip.
Remove any dust particles or debris from the chip surface before use.
Transfer the chip to the BioMark system for amplification.
Set the amplification conditions: 55 °C for 2 min, followed by 95 °C for 10 min, and then 40 cycles of 95 °C for 15 s and 55 °C for 1 min.
Follow the manufacturer's protocol for data collection software.
Use the qPCR analysis software to obtain amplification curves, heat maps, and Ct values for each well after RT-PCR.
